items.question: Why work with me
items.answer: You keep a single point of contact, from the first conversation to the long-term management of your asset. Your strategy, opportunity selection and negotiation are handled personally — then the full ecosystem (structuring, visas, banking, rental management) is coordinated for you through a trusted partner network. You are never handed off to another company.

items.question: My investment philosophy
items.answer: No opportunity is presented to you simply because it's available. Every recommendation is grounded in a rigorous assessment of its long-term value — never in market urgency. My role isn't to sell you a property, but to help you make an informed decision, at the pace that fits your objectives.

items.question: How I guide clients
items.answer: Every conversation starts with understanding your objectives, not presenting a property. You get a clear explanation of every option — tax, legal, financial — before you decide. And the guidance doesn't stop at signing: I stay by your side for rental management, resale, or portfolio optimization, years after the acquisition.

items.question: What you can expect from me
items.answer: A personal reply within 24–48 hours. Full transparency on costs, risks and alternatives. No sales pressure. And a single point of contact, available long after the handover.

items.question: Can a non-resident buy property in Dubai?
items.answer: Yes. In designated freehold areas, foreigners can acquire full ownership of a property, with no residency requirement.

items.question: What taxes apply to my rental income and resale?
items.answer: In the United Arab Emirates, individuals' rental income and real estate capital gains are not taxed. Your tax situation in your country of residence should still be reviewed with your tax advisor.

items.question: Can I finance my purchase?
items.answer: Financing solutions exist for both residents and non-residents. Terms vary by profile and are assessed on a case-by-case basis.

items.question: Does a real estate investment grant access to a visa?
items.answer: Subject to certain investment thresholds, a Dubai real estate purchase can qualify for a residency visa, including the Golden Visa.

items.question: Is your service available in French?
items.answer: Yes. My entire service, from the first conversation to the management of your asset, is provided in French.

about.title: Twenty years in sales taught me what not to do.
about.intro: I'm Tommy Walid, a real estate investment advisor based in Dubai. Before guiding clients, I spent nearly twenty years in sales — long enough to know exactly what I didn't want to become.
about.licenseNote: As a real estate investment advisor, I operate under a RERA-licensed brokerage in Dubai.
about.videoLabel: A personal introduction video is coming soon.

sections.title: The Path
sections.body: Originally from Réunion Island, I spent nearly twenty years in sales and business development before specializing in real estate. My time at Eagle Hills in Morocco brought me close to Dubai's world for the first time. A personal trip sealed the decision — the ambition of the city, but even more, how transparent the buying process looked compared to anything I'd known before.

sections.title: The Turning Point
sections.body: It wasn't one bad boss who shaped how I work — it was a pattern I watched repeat, job after job, year after year: clients pushed toward bad decisions for a commission. I decided to do the opposite: educate first, advise second, sell last.

sections.title: Why Dubai, For Me
sections.body: Dubai still surprises me — its ambition, and the sheer range of people building a life here: investors, entrepreneurs, families from every corner of the world. It's a city where the market's rigor and transparency make possible what would feel far less certain elsewhere.

sections.title: Where This Is Going
sections.body: I'm not trying to build a large firm. I'd rather stay small enough to know every client personally than manage volume. The day I can no longer personally answer every message is the day I'll have grown in the wrong direction.

about.quote: My objective is simple: my clients should sleep well, knowing their wealth is invested intelligently.

principles.description: Avant de vous montrer quoi que ce soit, je prends le temps de comprendre votre situation réelle — vos objectifs, vos contraintes, votre horizon. Pas un questionnaire type : une vraie conversation.

principles.title: Sélectionner avec discipline
principles.description: Je ne vous montre pas tout ce qui existe sur le marché. J'écarte moi-même ce qui ne correspond pas, pour ne vous présenter que ce qui mérite votre attention.

principles.title: Des options comparées, jamais une solution unique

principles.title: Je coordonne les bonnes personnes

principles.title: Une stratégie qui évolue avec vous
